# Jitter RNG health test vector: adaptive proportion test (APT), intermittent.
#
# One delta repeated. The APT counts how often the symbol a window opens on
# recurs within it, so reaching its cutoff of 459 at osr 3 needs that many
# identical deltas - and identical back-to-back deltas are stuck, and are what
# the lag predictor predicts perfectly. The RCT and the lag predictor therefore
# fire long before the APT does and are expected in the verdict alongside it:
# no sequence of time stamps reaches the APT cutoff without passing theirs.
#
# 975 measurements, enough for the APT cutoff of 459 and short of its permanent 479.
#
# One decimal time stamp per line. Replay with:
#   tests/health/health --replay <this file>
